subject: Time-boxed POC — billing holdback & support swap proposal
messages:
From: Alice Chen <alice@storixlabs.com>
To: mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai
Cc: rajiv.g@storixlabs.com
Date: 2026-06-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Pilot extension and alternative to additional spend

Hi Mateo,

Quick one from our side after the demo yesterday — team wants to extend the three-week POC by another three weeks to finish the integration and get enough production-like traffic. We don't have budget to top up the original committed spend, but we can be flexible on contracting structure. Two asks:

1) Can Redwood convert remaining unused credits into engineering support hours (for on-call help + a couple of joint tuning sessions)?
2) If conversion isn't possible, would Redwood consider holding back a portion of the invoice (e.g., 10-20%) until post-POC acceptance milestones are met?

Both paths would help us move forward without a fresh prepay. We want to avoid a hard stop and ensure we can validate throughput under realistic load. Happy to jump on a quick call to discuss the operational details.

Thanks,
Alice Chen
Head of ML Engineering
Storix Labs

Attachments: none
From: mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai
To: Alice Chen <alice@storixlabs.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-06-02T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot extension and alternative to additional spend

Alice — thanks for the clear asks and for the time yesterday. Really appreciate the quick feedback from your engineers. Below is a concrete proposal that should address both of your concerns while keeping contract/legal churn minimal.

Proposal (commercial + operational):
- Extension: +3 weeks to the current time-boxed POC, new end date = 2026-07-01.
- Support swap: Convert up to $12,000 of remaining prepaid credit into 40 hours of Redwood engineering support (on-call + two joint tuning sessions). These hours are for incident response, model/serving tuning, and one on-site/virtual workshop.
- Billing holdback: Redwood will accept a 15% invoice holdback on the extension period. Holdback released within 14 days after post-POC acceptance criteria are met (acceptance = successful 48-hour production-like run with <5% error rate and token latency under agreed SLO).
- MAP (mutual action plan): We attach an updated SOW that defines the acceptance criteria, milestone checklist, and responsibilities. If you sign the SOW, we'll provision the extended capacity the next business day.

Operational notes:
- The support hours are tracked and deducted from the converted credit; unused hours expire at the end of the extension period.
- If you prefer credits instead of hours, we can keep the $12k as account credits with the same expiration and use constraints.
- Legal: minimal edits only to the SOW; price and holdback mechanics are spelled out in the attached. I linked a DocuSign so we can turn this quickly: https://docusign.net/Storix-POC-SOW-v2

If that looks reasonable I can loop in contracts/legal for a fast sign and schedule the provisioning. Neha and Jasmine are cc'd to help operationalize the support schedule and acceptance testing.

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
Sr. Account Executive — Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0172

Attachments: Storix_POC_SOW_v2.pdf (SOW with acceptance criteria, support hour table, payment/holdback terms)
From: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
To: mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai
Cc: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-06-03T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: internal: Storix concession check

Mateo — quick internal thread.

Neha: 15% holdback + 40 hours seems okay if we cap total concession exposure. Can we cap the converted credit to $12k and require an acceptance sign-off form? Also prefer a 10-business-day release after acceptance to align with billing.

Jasmine: I can own the scheduling of support hours and the acceptance runbook. One ask: reduce the support hour expiration to end of extension week (so 3-week window) and allow up to two rollover hours if they missed scheduled ops (max 2).

Short reply from Mateo (internal): agree to $12k cap; will accept a 10-business-day release if Alice pushes back on 14 days. Willing to give 30 hours instead of 40 if Alice insists on a lower holdback — tradeoff conversation on call.

—end internal note—
From: Alice Chen <alice@storixlabs.com>
To: mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai
Cc: Rajiv Gupta <rajiv.g@storixlabs.com>
Date: 2026-06-04T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot extension and alternative to additional spend

Thanks Mateo — that direction is helpful. Two quick clarifications before we sign:

1) Can we move to 12% holdback (we're sensitive to finance holds across multiple vendors) and accept 30 support hours converted from credits?
2) Please confirm that unused support hours expire at the end of the 3-week extension and that holdback release will be 10 business days after acceptance.

If you confirm those two items I will sign the SOW via the DocuSign link and we can start provisioning. Appreciate the flexibility — want to keep momentum.

Best,
Alice
Head of ML Engineering
Storix Labs
